For the fat family (high-degree polynomials with increasing complexity), use symbolic complexity bounds to show that Kolmogorov complexity grows super-linearly with w, and empirically demonstrate that width requirements exceed h=64 for moderate w, indicating unbounded capacity needs. This approach separates representational limits from optimization difficulty.
